c.proof: Exact saved native compile command and output, historical executable SHA or retime command-asset pin, complete measured source and original sample/report binding. Saved compiler version only when independently linked to its actual compile command.

cpp.proof: Same native build boundary as C; separate summary/replication origin for local shared-products row. Compiler family is actual saved compiler, never upstream submission label.

rust.proof: Saved rustc native command or exact Cargo manifest/dependency-lock/native-output lineage, historical executable SHA and actual command/sample/source. Shared-products and floating-CDF have separate saved local source/build records.

mech.proof: Each of six timing report families independently resolves to its real source/build/native-object/native-binary origin. Linker/emitter command and actual executed binary SHA bind the authored main; no upstream or present compiler substitution.

mech-jit.proof: Final execution-mode timing row explicitly says mode=jit, invokes the exact host/source/mode/optimization flags and records host SHA. Final objects and earlier source builds plus exact source/runner hashes are preserved; final host is not replaced by earlier build runner.

mech-resident.proof: Actual after-phase row explicitly says resident, exact after host SHA/source/command, integration baseline and saved resident Machine::call disassembly/code-path audit. Preserve loaded-region sample time and its original full-process/preparation fields.

julia.proof: Actual saved Julia version/runtime invocation and corresponding cohort producer/source/sample binding prove native runtime platform. Upgrade to native-jit only with actual saved mode evidence; execution_mode=julia is not the literal jit. Retime command-assets separately preserve historical binary SHA. Later regex/Pi retain missing historical byte identity without losing a proved platform; never borrow an older pin merely from equal path/version.

javascript.proof: Saved actual Node command/version/runtime source receipt plus corresponding cohort producer/sample binding can prove JavaScript platform. Retain unknown execution when original ambient NODE_OPTIONS was not captured, and separate missing historical executable byte identity. Legacy regex cannot borrow an older pin merely from equal path/version.

confidence_rule: Saved actual version/command/runtime receipt plus corresponding cohort producer/source/sample binding may prove platform while execution and executable-byte identity remain separately unknown. Missing mode or byte evidence does not erase proved platform; missing cohort-bound runtime observation does. Mode-specific native-jit/interpreter keys require actual saved mode evidence. All draft confidence flags remain false until guarded qualification.
current_binaries_rule: An under-lock hash of an available artifact can corroborate an existing historical SHA, never create the missing historical SHA or a historical compiler/runtime version. Newly observed Mach-O/image metadata must be labeled as observation of the exact unchanged historical artifact; it never stands in for a saved measurement/runtime receipt.
sample_rule: Require exact preserved displayed array and median, minimum three actual samples; retain seven-sample confirmation arrays and loaded-interpreter timing boundary. No sample conversion, warmed-process reinterpretation or retiming.
existing100_and_new120: Both already reviewed routes remain separate immutable inputs. This additive route does not alter their qualified rows or erase unknown records; stage all selected existing identities before endpoint selection, then combine compatible disjoint changes transactionally.
